ranking_reason: The illustrative contract requires 100-year exact recovery, three dependency-independent failure domains, two independent readers, and a 10-day full restore. A 1 PB decimal payload over 10 days requires at least 1.157 GB/s aggregate user-payload throughput before metadata, mounts, ECC, retries, verification or network overhead. The published LTO-10 headline is up to 400 MB/s per drive; three drives provide only a 1.2 GB/s arithmetic upper bound and do not demonstrate an end-to-end library restore. The glass publication's 65.9 Mbit/s figure is a four-beam write rate, not a restore rate. Available public sources do not establish the full contract on a matched system boundary. No score or recommendation is emitted.
